SELECT CONTRACT_NO FROM TB_CTR_LGD WHERE INSURED_ID = #{insuredId} AND INSR_CLS_CD = '05' AND CTR_STAT_CD IN ('20', '30') AND START_DATE <= #{treatDate} AND #{treatDate} < LEAST(END_DATE, COALESCE(TERM_DT, END_DATE)) ORDER BY CONTRACT_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CLM_MED_ITEM (CLM_NO, SEQ, TREAT_DT, CARE_TYPE, FACILITY_TYPE, FACILITY_NM, COVERED_AMT, NON_COVERED_AMT, SOURCE_CD) VALUES (#{clmNo}, #{seq}, #{treatDt}, #{careType}, #{facilityType}, #{facilityNm}, #{coveredAmt}, #{nonCoveredAmt}, #{sourceCd})
mapper.select: SELECT SEQ, CARE_TYPE, FACILITY_TYPE, COVERED_AMT, NON_COVERED_AMT FROM TB_CLM_MED_ITEM WHERE CLM_NO = #{clmNo} ORDER BY SEQ

SELECT SEQ, TREAT_DT, CARE_TYPE, FACILITY_TYPE, FACILITY_NM, COVERED_AMT, NON_COVERED_AMT, COVERED_ASSESSED, NON_COVERED_ASSESSED, COVERED_DEDUCT, COVERED_PAY, NON_COVERED_DEDUCT, NON_COVERED_PAY, SOURCE_CD FROM TB_CLM_MED_ITEM WHERE CLM_NO = #{clmNo} ORDER BY SEQ
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CLM_MED_SHARE (CLM_NO, CVRG_CD, INSURER_CD, POLICY_NO, LIABILITY_AMT, SHARE_AMT) VALUES (#{clmNo}, #{cvrgCd}, #{insurerCd}, #{policyNo}, #{liabilityAmt}, #{shareAmt})
mapper.select: SELECT CVRG_CD, CARE_TYPE, FACILITY_GRADE, COPAY_RATE, MIN_DEDUCT_AMT AS MIN_DEDUCT, PER_VISIT_LIMIT FROM TB_PRD_MED_RULE WHERE PRD_CD = #{prdCd}
